    Integral relations from real two-generator cones #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_nat_relation_of_real_tensor_relation {G : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup G] (x y z : G) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (h : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] x + b ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y = 1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ), 0 < p ∧ m • x + n • y = p • z

    A real nonnegative two-generator relation between integral classes becomes a relation with natural coefficients after multiplication. Any torsion in the group of classes is killed by an additional positive factor.
